en.title: Investigation into school attack shares in Manisa
en.summary: Authorities are investigating provocative social media posts made following an incident at a school in Turgutlu district of Manisa.

stories.title: Manisa'daki saldırı sonrası sosyal medya paylaşımlarına soruşturma

en.title: Investigation into social media shares after Manisa attack
en.summary: The Ankara Chief Public Prosecutor's Office launched an investigation into allegedly provocative social media posts made following an attack at a high school in Manisa.

stories.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan Bloomberg'e yazdı: 'BMGK'da veto hakkı kaldırılmalı'

en.title: President Erdoğan wrote to Bloomberg: 'Veto right should be removed from UN Security Council'
en.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wrote an article for Bloomberg addressing the veto mechanism in the United Nations Security Council.

stories.title: İçişleri, Manisa'daki okul saldırısı için 4 müfettiş görevlendirdi

en.title: Interior Ministry assigned 4 inspectors for school attack in Manisa
en.summary: The Interior Ministry appointed two Chief Governors' Inspectors and two Police Chief Inspectors to conduct a comprehensive investigation into an armed attack at a vocational high school in Turgutlu, Manisa.

stories.title: Son dakika... RTÜK'ten Manisa'daki okul saldırısına yayın yasağı

en.title: RTÜK imposes broadcast ban on school attack in Manisa
en.summary: Turkey's media regulator RTÜK has imposed a broadcast ban regarding an armed attack that occurred this morning outside a vocational school in Turgutlu, Manisa.

stories.title: Turgutlu'da okul saldırısı: 3 öğrenci Manisa'ya sevk edildi

en.title: School attack in Turgutlu: 3 students transferred to Manisa
en.summary: An armed attack on students waiting for a school bus in Turgutlu, Manisa wounded 11 students. Three of the wounded in critical condition were transferred to a university hospital for further treatment.

stories.title: Manisa'daki okul saldırısı Meclis gündeminde: '5 ayda ne yaptınız?'

en.title: Manisa school attack becomes Parliament agenda: 'What did you do in 5 months?'
en.summary: Following an armed shooting incident at a school in Turgutlu, Manisa, the matter has been brought to Parliament's attention with questions raised about prior actions.

stories.title: İstanbul’daki şüpheli ölümde yeni detaylar: Teyzeye mesaj, telefonda 4 dakikalık video

en.title: New details in suspicious death in Istanbul: Message to aunt, 4-minute video on phone
en.summary: A private security officer was found dead from a gunshot wound in his Istanbul home. Investigation reveals he sent a farewell message to his aunt and left a video recording on his phone.

stories.title: ACNTÜRK Sigorta soruşturmasında 23 şüpheli gözaltına alındı

en.title: 23 suspects detained in ACNTÜRK Insurance investigation
en.summary: Turkish authorities detained 23 suspects in an investigation into ACNTÜRK Insurance, where the company's actual capital was allegedly 14 million lira despite different documentation during its establishment.

stories.title: Gözler BM Genel Kurulu'nda: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan kürsüden yine Filistin'in sesi olacak

en.title: Eyes on UN General Assembly: President Erdoğan will again be the voice of Palestine from the podium
en.summary: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan is expected to draw international attention to events in Gaza during the UN General Assembly, advocating for an independent Palestinian state within 1967 borders with East Jerusalem as its capital.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA | Fon soruşturmasında yeni dalga operasyon: 14 şüpheli gözaltına alındı

en.title: BREAKING | New wave operation in fund investigation: 14 suspects detained
en.summary: Justice Minister Akın Gürlek announced a new wave of operations in a fund investigation, with simultaneous operations conducted in Istanbul and Aydın resulting in the detention of 14 suspects.

stories.title: Başkan Erdoğan'dan BMGK için reform mesajı: Veto imtiyazı kaldırılmalı

en.title: President Erdoğan's reform message for UN Security Council: Veto privilege should be abolished
en.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan called for UN Security Council reform, stating that lasting global peace cannot be achieved when disconnected blocs multiply and fail to communicate with one another.

stories.title: Gurbetçiler artık fındığını satmıyor: Yeni yöntem giderek yayılıyor

en.title: Migrant Workers No Longer Selling Their Hazelnuts: New Method Spreading
en.summary: Migrant workers in Giresun have shifted their hazelnut processing approach after harvest season, now cracking and processing nuts into spreads and roasted products at boutique workshops to sell in their cities of residence rather than selling raw nuts.

stories.title: 920 bin TL'lik taksi ücretini görünce şoke oldu

en.title: Driver Shocked Upon Seeing 920,000 TL Taxi Fare
en.summary: An Istanbul taxi driver discovered his customer accidentally transferred 920,000 TL instead of 920 TL for a ride. The 26-year veteran driver returned to the barbershop where he had dropped off the passenger to refund the excess amount.

stories.title: Bu yıl bekçi alımı yapılacak mı, ne zaman yapılacak?

en.title: Will Security Guard Recruitment Happen This Year, When Will It Occur?
en.summary: Security guard recruitment has not occurred for an extended period, with candidates continuously seeking updates from the Interior Ministry about when hiring will take place.

stories.title: Manisa'daki okul saldırısına ilişkin yayın yasağı getirildi

en.title: Broadcasting Ban Imposed on Manisa School Attack
en.summary: A broadcasting ban has been implemented regarding a armed attack in Turgutlu, Manisa, as part of ongoing judicial investigation, according to a decision by the local peace criminal court.

stories.title: Manisa'da okullar tatil mi? Manisa'da yarın okul var mı?

en.title: Are schools closed in Manisa? Will there be school in Manisa tomorrow?
en.summary: An attack occurred at a school in Manisa's Turgutlu district, injuring 11 people. Following the incident, questions arose about the status of schools in the area.
